zoe: Quick heads-up: 2pm PT sync today to align vendor ETAs for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Core asks: driver/firmware freeze, embargo buffers, SI handoff checklist, and regional power constraints.

matt: invite sent. agenda: 1) firmware freeze dates + tags 2) SI integration windows 3) marketplace SKU metadata fields 4) fallback-model policy if perf regresses

oliver: perf note  H200 long-seq runs hit thermal derate on EU racks last week. we need partners to confirm thermal counters and power patches.

tara: labs: can host multi-node runs Fri-Sat if canaries arrive by Wed EOD. require signed images.

vendor-bot: Available tags: h100-fw-2024-05-02, h200-canary:v1.2.0, b200-image:v20240503, mi300-fw-2024-04-28, gaudi-driver:v1.9.

zoe: marketplace metadata note: include fields max_seq, recommended_quant, fallback_tag, region_limits. we'll circulate a schema PR.

matt: marketing wants a 7-day buffer after driver freeze for docs. vendors please confirm freeze dates.

oliver: propose fallback: if perf regression >10% on H200, preview will use B200-compatible variant by default. can we codify that?

tara: labs will block Fri-Sat once canaries are signed. SI leads please confirm peering test availability.

vendor-bot: Meeting link https://meet.redwood.ai/partners/1714005000.

zoe: Action items: 1) vendors confirm freeze tags in-thread (vendors) 2) perf run on canaries (oliver) 3) labs carve (tara) 4) schema PR (matt) 5) draft fallback policy (zoe). Reply with "ACK + tag". I'll post minutes after the call. :white_check_mark:
